meta_description:
5,743 likes, 89 comments - casarthakahuja on October 5, 2026: "50 crores in funding is being given to anyone who decides to move their company to Qatar… as a relocation grant…

They are also giving subsidised housing, Co working spaces and waiving off registration fees for licenses plus giving you an entrepreneur visa…

And I’ll give you three hacks to improve your chances of selection…

This is a program started by the Qatar Investment Program and Qatar Development Bank…

And look at the terms on offer…

There are two programs, START and GROW, and here’s a dive into both of them.

1/ START Program: which is giving USD 1.1 Mn at the idea and MVP stage where you have to showcase them a business model, your innovation, and the capability of the founders

2/ Under GROW, you get USD 5.5 Mn of funding where your startup is already functioning, but they want you to expand in Qatar and the Middle East…

Here, you need to have at least 3 years of operating history…

Now here’s how you can improve your chances:

1/ In your deck, show specifically a plan for how much of the Qatar market can you access and provide your solution in and monetise, plus why Qatar is perfect beyond just the capital… show them why they’re good beyond just the money

2/ Build timeline based milestones and deliverables from your end against which they can map a tranche based disbursal

3/ Explain how many people will you be willing to move to Qatar or hire in Qatar because they want tangible on ground execution than just mailbox presence

To apply, you must visit startupqatar <dot> qa/en/investment-program

All the best

#casarthakahuja".
